title: prune_reopened_refs judges a gone item file against the integration main, not the checkout it runs in
goal: Found by the fresh-context review of SP-matmvkn6, item ST-ihtjygip (Sprint close and drop delete the refs/kb-reopened ref of each item they remove): refs/kb-reopened/* is shared by every worktree of a clone, but prune_reopened_refs judges an item file gone by the checkout the command runs in, so a drop outside a sprint run in an older worktree deletes the reopen ref of a live item filed on main after that worktree branched. The prune deletes a ref only when the item file is absent from the integration main tree too (origin/main), and a ref of an item that exists there is kept.
